mapper.select: SELECT /* getAdminAuthList */ P.ADMN_NUMB , P.ADMN_IDXX , P.ADMN_NAME , P.AUTH_CODE , P.AUTH_NAME , P.DEPT_CODE FROM ( SELECT R.ADMN_NUMB , R.ADMN_IDXX , R.ADMN_NAME , R.AUTH_CODE , R.AUTH_NAME , R.DEPT_CODE , ROWNUM AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT A.ADMN_NUMB , A.ADMN_IDXX , A.ADMN_NAME , A.AUTH_CODE , G.AUTH_NAME , A.DEPT_CODE FROM TM_ADMINX A LEFT JOIN TM_AUTHXM G ON G.AUTH_CODE = A.AUTH_CODE ORDER BY A.ADMN_NUMB ) R WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB >= #{startRow}
SELECT /* getAdminCount */ COUNT(*) FROM TM_ADMINX WHERE ADMN_NUMB = #{admnNumb}
